reply.text: Honestly, flys are a good place to chase it. Cables keep tension on the chest through the whole range, which free weights don't, so the burn there is real muscle work. Just don't let the burn become the scoreboard. It tells you the muscle is working, not that you're getting stronger, so keep adding reps or load over the weeks the same way you would on a press. If you want, I can check how your chest work has been trending and see where flys fit in your week.
